name: mdx-harness-runway

gate_order.done_when: north star, runway, source map, check, ADR, and draft cleanup are committed together.
typed harness run admission schema exists with tenant, actor, surface, mode, scope, policy profile, enterprise pack, budget, quality gates, and exit criteria.
deterministic local plan-only runner emits a plan item, policy decision, receipt, and write refusal proof.
append-only run items support audit replay from durable local artifacts.
read/search/list and first patch or test tools are policy mediated, capped, redacted, timed, and receipt-backed.
coding-turn model profiles route through deterministic tests and fail-closed live adapters.
ModelGateway, MemoryStore, and WorkflowRunner use one governed contract per capability, local Rust defaults, vendor slots, driver identity in receipts, and conformance gates.
the local Rust ModelGateway satisfies the same governed contract and receipt shape as any vendor driver without live provider calls.
the local MemoryStore satisfies the same governed contract and receipt shape as any vendor memory driver.
the local Rust WorkflowRunner satisfies the same governed contract and receipt shape as any durable workflow driver.
workers execute with sponsor, scope, expiry, budget, credentials, handoff evidence, and retirement.
Temporal, provider gateway, memory, telemetry, Render, and deployment are turned on only through observed evidence receipts.

hard_stops: do not create a new crate before the mdx-core harness module has independent tests and a clear ownership boundary
do not treat generated contracts, docs, or plans as execution authority without a receipt-backed policy admission
do not store canonical runtime state in .mdx-local; it is ignored local proof evidence only
do not treat vendor turn-on as a prerequisite for governed local action when a conforming local driver exists
do not run external machines before a fail-closed local adapter denial proof exists
do not mark live substrate, worker, provider, or ship claims green without observed evidence
